Bake small potatoes, halve and scoop, brush with butter, crisp at 220C, fill with cheddar and bacon, bake again, sour cream and chives.
M: cheese, tortilla, done properly in a pan
Flour tortillas filled with grated cheddar and Monterey Jack, folded, cooked in a dry pan over medium heat until golden and melted. Salsa and sour cream.
Uncle Rico's rump steak and corn
the steak Rico throws at Napoleon from the van

Rump steak seared hard in a smoking pan, rested and sliced, with corn on the cob in paprika butter and a pile of crispy smashed potatoes. Season 4 rump steaks (about 220g each) with salt and pepper 30 minutes ahead. Boil 800g baby potatoes until tender, smash flat on an oiled tray and roast at 220C for 25 minutes. Boil 4 corn cobs for 6 minutes and roll in 50g butter mixed with 1 tsp paprika. Sear the steaks in a smoking hot pan with 1 tbsp oil for 3 minutes a side for medium rare, rest 5 minutes, slice and serve with the corn and potatoes.
W: Vanilla cake baked in a dome with a hollow centre filled with lollies, covered in bright buttercream stripes so it spills when cut.
K: FFA blue ribbon chocolate malt shake
Napoleon judges the milk at the FFA contest

Cold full cream milk blended thick with chocolate ice cream, malted milk powder and a pinch of salt, topped with whipped cream and chocolate shavings. Put 600ml cold full cream milk, 6 scoops chocolate ice cream, 4 tbsp malted milk powder and a pinch of salt in a blender. Blend for 30 seconds until thick and smooth. Pour into 4 chilled tall glasses. Whip 150ml thickened cream to soft peaks, spoon on top and grate 20g dark chocolate over each.

s.note: kept in your pocket for later
s.how: Parboil 800g potatoes for 8 minutes, cool and grate. Squeeze dry and season with salt and 1 tsp onion powder. Shape into little cylinders and freeze 30 minutes. Fry at 180C until golden and crisp all over.

Bake 8 small potatoes at 200C for 45 minutes, halve and scoop out most of the flesh. Brush with 30g melted butter and crisp at 220C for 10 minutes. Fill with 150g grated cheddar and 4 rashers crisp bacon, bake 5 minutes more, top with sour cream and chives.

m.note: cheese, tortilla, done properly in a pan
m.how: Fill 8 flour tortillas with 150g grated cheddar and 150g Monterey Jack, then fold in half. Cook in a dry pan over medium heat for 3 minutes a side until golden and melted. Serve with diced tomato salsa and sour cream.

w.how: Beat 200g butter and 200g sugar, add 4 eggs and fold in 250g self-raising flour and 100ml milk. Bake in an ovenproof bowl at 170C for 50 minutes. Hollow the centre, fill with 200g lollies and cover with 400g icing sugar beaten with 250g butter in bright stripes.
